extension.summary: Live Runtime Inspector for Kodi Addons
extension.description: Monitor live addon behavior with targeted research wizard. Extract favorites systems, debug download flows, compare addon versions, audit UI messages. Features 6 monitoring modules, 9 research types, SQLite session history, and multi-format exports (JSON, AI Handoff, Compact, Detailed).
